statement: This map is an index into the repository, not an authority over it. Future Gate audits must verify each relevant entry against the current source before relying on it -- a stale entry is a documentation bug, not a contract change.

canonicalState.notes: Defines StateModelSchema/StateModel, the canonical overall on-disk state shape and its schema version.

candidateStateValidation.notes: readStateModel() runs assertCompatibleVersion before StateModelSchema.safeParse; writeStateModel() also gates the candidate model version before persistence. Project/store behavior mirrors this in src/state/project-store.ts.

atomicStateWrite.notes: atomicWriteFileSync() is the sole atomic-write primitive; writeStateModel() and safe-writer helpers build on it.

runlogStore.notes: appendRunlogEvent/readRunlogEventIds/inspectRunlogHealth plus all build*Event() builder functions (~40, including M28's buildEvidenceGatePolicyImportedEvent/buildEvidenceGatePolicyActivatedEvent).

canonicalJson.notes: canonicalizeJsonValue/canonicalJsonStringify/computeCanonicalPayloadDigest -- the single canonicalization implementation, introduced in M23 and reused directly by M28.

sha256Digest.notes: sha256Hex() is the sole hashing primitive; computeCanonicalPayloadDigest builds on it.

exitCodeOwner.notes: ExitCode const map and ExitCodeValue type; AiqtError carries an ExitCode, register-commands.ts maps thrown errors to the process exit code.

boundedInput.notes: readBoundedTextFile() plus readStdinText() are the size-bounded input readers used by every file/stdin import command.

jsonOutput.notes: renderJson() plus the CommandResult shape; register-commands.ts is the central --json dispatch point.

previewBehavior.notes: Canonical --preview implementation (M9/M20). This is a repeated per-command pattern (see graph repair's --dry-run/--apply), not a single shared preview module -- new preview-style commands should follow this file's pattern, not assume a shared helper exists.

evidenceSchema.notes: EvidenceRecordSchema and ArtifactReference/ArtifactKind (M22); the sole evidence-taxonomy owner, reused directly by M28's evidenceSelector.artifactKinds.

evidenceTrust.notes: TRUST_LEVEL_ORDER and meetsTrustLevel(), co-located with the evidence schema (M22): unverified < self_reported < repository_local < platform_verified.

packetLifecycle.notes: Creation via buildPacketContext/computePacketAuditMetadata (invoked from next.command.ts); cancellation via next-cancel.command.ts orchestrating buildPacketCancelledEvent and applyWorkUnitCancelTransition.

executionSessions.notes: Execution session schema and protocol constants (M26); service functions getExecutionSessions/findSessionsForWorkUnit/findAnySessionForPacket (M27).

externalExecutionAdapters.notes: Normalizes Claude Code adapter results into the generic execution-result shape (M27); generic external-adapter CLI path lives in execution-external-request.command.ts.

evidenceGatePolicy.notes: Policy/rule schema and bounds (MAX_POLICIES, MAX_RULES_PER_POLICY, etc.), introduced in M28.

evidenceGateSimulation.notes: evaluateRule()/aggregateOverallResult()/simulate() -- the sole pure, read-only simulation entry point, introduced in M28. Never imports runlog-store, atomic-write, or workflow-state-store.

statusCommand.notes: runStatus(); as of M28 optionally includes a read-only evidenceGate summary field.

workflowAssessment.notes: M32 establishes assessWorkflow() and WORKFLOW_RECOMMENDATION_RULES as the authoritative workflow-position, recommendation, integrity, and project-status owner. Legacy helpers remain only as compatibility adapters over assessWorkflow(); persisted nextRecommendedCommand is a recomputed compatibility cache.

reviewCommand.notes: runReviewCommand() and the runReview()/review-rules evaluation it delegates to.

versioningPolicy.notes: package.json's version field is the single canonical version source; runVersionCheck()/version-check-cli.ts implement the policy's automated checks (pnpm version:check).

ciWorkflows.notes: The sole GitHub Actions workflow (name: Validate), matrix build on Node 22 and 24 -- no other workflow files exist.

historicalCompatibilityFixtures.notes: cli.test.ts's 'aiqt CLI entrypoint' describe block carries the original per-milestone command-set/exit-code assertions; later milestones (M22+) split their own dedicated historical-compatibility test files rather than extending it.
